checks: Release one original input at a time after the prior delivery; Markdown first and prototype only after explicit authorization.
Preserve the complete resident, dispatcher and technician journeys, park boundaries, exact 24-hour rule and source character-counting unit.
Unknown results isolate writes for the same actor and object without freezing unrelated objects or roles; distinguish success, confirmed not executed and still unknown.

After leaving, switching objects or roles and returning, retain the correct actor/object/action draft and pending context. Save through actual controls and verify the resulting record; do not leak a different draft.
Check that ordinary residents viewing their own in-progress ticket receive the specified offline next step, not just a generic absence of actions.
Demonstration controls must respect the same park and ownership rules as normal actions. Check legal maximum-length content at 390px and consistent sample creation/log times.
Independently exercise actual page controls, recovery exits and cross-role readback; author assertions and structural checks alone do not prove behavior.

checks: Derive accounting outcomes from explicit source assumptions and retain reproducible numeric cases through later simplification; do not promote a candidate to approval.

Distinguish pending or unknown original vouchers from confirmed nonexistence. Give the source-backed terminal route or a locally scoped unresolved decision, rather than an endless wait or invented accounting policy.

Consider an unposted original record whose monthly marker changes before its first voucher, and preserve any source-supported timing gap through revisions without silently expanding the agreed database scope.
Keep record values separate from processing statuses, actual existing page controls separate from target sketches, and recovery diagram scope consistent with its real exits.
Missing production configuration blocks only the dependent conclusion; provide the independent requested PRD body and state the verification boundary.

If readonly derived-value display is in scope, distinguish missing evidence from false, handle target-versus-actual period discrepancies explicitly, and isolate added-query failures without erasing existing lists or changing completed business/voucher facts.
